notes.title: 🎉🎮 Controller Support is Here! 🎮🎉
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198830/0135f5754d2c264122087d4e8dd8ff4c2f0bd569.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Controller Support is Here! 🎮[/b]

I'm excited to announce that [b]Pixelmancy[/b] now supports controllers! Whether you're using an Xbox, PlayStation, or other compatible controllers, you can now dive into the game with ease.

[b]What’s new?[/b]
[list] [*] Full controller support throughout the entire game. [*] Two different aim modes with adjustable sensitivity settings. [*] Full rebinding of keybindings to customize your controls.  [/list]
Thank you for your support - happy gaming! 🎉💜

notes.title: Discord server
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce the launch of our official Pixelmancy Discord server! 🎮✨ If you're a fan of the game or just curious about it, this is the perfect place for you.

Welcome to the Pixelmancy community! 🌟 Here, you’ll get frequent updates, have direct access to me, the developer, and receive exclusive sneak peeks at upcoming features. Join us to stay in the loop, share feedback, and help shape the future of Pixelmancy.

Click here to join the community and be part of our journey: [url=https://discord.gg/aMHpFEYdMe]Discord server[/url] 🔗

Thank you for your continued support, and I can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: Playtest Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I’m thrilled to announce that the playtest for [b]Pixelmancy [/b]is now live! 🎮 
I would love for you to dive in, explore, and share your feedback.

Your insights are invaluable in shaping the game's future, so if you have some time, please fill out this [url=https://forms.gle/zbXVRXXZweoKtbp2A]Google Playtest Form[/url]. It will help me improve and refine the game based on your experience.

Thank you so much for your support! ♡
